fact: Keycloak admin user defaults to admin; keycloakPassword defaults to judo (JUDO_PLATFORM_KEYCLOAK_USER / _PASSWORD).
Boolean view fields become TrinaryLogicCombo in the view transformation; the BooleanTypeCheckbox rule is commented out, so booleanWidget=CHECKBOX does not select a checkbox.
View inputs use `widget <WidgetType> <name>`; `field` is not a view member.
View link accepts only visual, create-form, update-view and selector-table modifiers; required, enabled, default, choices, eager, delete and text are rejected.
View table accepts only action-group, visual, create-form, update-view and selector-table modifiers; enabled, default, choices, eager, create, delete, update and rows are not accepted.
DownloadServlet has no configurable size limit; only UploadServlet has maxSize.
CLI transform runs on the live in-memory model, including unsaved edits.
CLI save serializes the model first, writes a temp file, then atomically moves it over the model file.
CLI transform runs an esm2ui step (skippable with --skip esm2ui) and writes the UI model.
.generator-ignore entries are glob patterns only; '!' negation is not supported, and ignore files in parent directories also apply.
ModelGenerator.resetChecksums(GeneratorParameter) builds checksum removers but never runs them.
The JSL validator does not reject binary primitives as identifiers; it rejects only calculated identifiers and numeric identifiers with scale.
Update channel is set with -Djudo-version-update-channel=<channel> (default develop); -DupdateChannel does not bind.
Repository server id is set with -Djudo-version-rules-serverId (default serverId); -DserverId does not bind.
Filestore expirationTime of 0 or less issues tokens without exp, so they never expire.
